text:
Maya (CS): @here quick heads-up — Helio Health onboarding showing elevated p95 latency this morning, customer flagged experience regressions during trial :thinking_face:

Jonas (SRE): Can you paste the session IDs or a timeframe? I pulled some traces, looks like a few long tails around 02:15-02:40 UTC. :eyes:

Maya (CS): Window is 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC. Sample session IDs: s-94a2, s-94a7, s-94b1. Customer noticed UI stalls when generating summaries.

Jonas (SRE): Thanks. quick grep from the runtime logs:
```
2026-03-20T02:18:12Z helio/s-94a2 model=redwood-v2 latency=623ms tokens=180
2026-03-20T02:22:07Z helio/s-94a7 model=redwood-v2 latency=1189ms tokens=450
2026-03-20T02:28:45Z helio/s-94b1 model=redwood-v1 quantized latency=2403ms tokens=700
```
Looks like a mix of model switches and large token counts. Could be batching + cold KV cache.

Priya (AE): Renewal for Helio is in 6 weeks. If this becomes a customer-quality story we risk discount asks. Can CS estimate potential credit exposure? small credits are fine, but we need to quantify. :grimacing:

Kara (Legal): Reminder: contract §4.2 defines latency SLOs and credit triggers for p95 > 800ms across their plan. We'll need evidence (traces + dashboard screenshots) for the billing period to validate any credit.

Maya (CS): Understood. Plan: 1) gather traces + p95 trend for last 7 days; 2) collect user repro steps; 3) coordinate a remediation canary with SRE; 4) prep one-pager for AE/legal. Assigning tasks below. :memo:

Maya (CS): @Jonas — can you capture aggregate p95 by hour for 3/14-3/20 and drop a short CSV? Also include model variant and token distribution if possible.

Jonas (SRE): On it. I'll export from Observability -> Queries. Expect CSV in ~30m. Will also flag any autoscale/queue saturation events.

infra-bot: deploy-event helio-prod: canary rollout redwood-v2 -> 2026-03-20T02:05:00Z triggered by infra/rollout.

Maya (CS): Good to know—canary aligns with the timeframe. Might explain the v1/v2 mix in logs.

Priya (AE): Once we have the CSV and screenshots, I'll draft a short renewal-note for Helio leadership emphasizing steps taken and expected fixes. Want to avoid a formal credit claim if we can show remediation path. :thumbsup:

Kara (Legal): If the p95 breach exceeds the threshold in any billing day, we still have to calculate prorated credits. AE + CS should avoid informal promises. I'll review the one-pager.

Maya (CS): Agreed. I'll collect evidence and assemble a customer-facing summary. Quick checkbox plan:
- [ ] p95 hourly CSV (Jonas)
- [ ] trace bundle + sample session logs (Jonas)
- [ ] dashboard screenshots (Maya)
- [ ] customer repro steps + timestamps (Helio contact)
- [ ] one-pager draft (Priya)
- [ ] legal review (Kara)

Jonas (SRE): Uploaded CSV to the shared folder: https://redwood.internal/obs/exports/helio-p95-3-14-3-20.csv
Also flagged two busy-host events at 02:20-02:30 UTC on 03/20; attaching trace IDs: t-998, t-999.

Maya (CS): Got it. Pulling screenshots now from Console -> Accounts -> Helio Health -> Metrics. Will attach to the deck.

Priya (AE): Can we set a short customer call tomorrow 09:00 PT to walk through? I want to lead with the remediation plan and avoid surprises.

Maya (CS): 09:00 PT works. I'll book a 30-min slot and share calendar invite.

Kara (Legal): Please include a line in the one-pager that clarifies we are investigating and that any credit calculation will follow the contract. I can help phrase it.

Maya (CS): Thanks. Final note: CS will also capture any enablement gaps the customer reported (e.g., large input sizes, model variant selection) and feed back into onboarding checklist so this doesn't recur. Will follow up after call with action items. :white_check_mark:
